summary.text: Rafael Macias is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives who has represented District 51 since December 3, 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Navy veteran of 22 years, he has worked as a professional photographer.

paragraphs.text: Rafael Macias served in the U.S. Navy for 22 years and attended the University of Missouri.
His career experience includes working as a professional photographer.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
